newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT EASES VS DLR, BCE SWISS FRANC, YEN DOWN.
newsitem.headline: FORINT EASES VS DLR, BCE SWISS FRANC, YEN DOWN.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the dollar on Monday a very slow afternoon session of the inter-bank forex market, traders said.
"There was virtually no trade in the afternoon," said Adam Szilagyi of ABN-AMRO.
The forint finished at 160.10/15 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 159.80/160.00 and kept its 60 pips distance from the central bank's resistance level.
